novelty.justification: The novelty route is the proposed phenomenon and measurement that “connective/filler/restating tokens” converge shallowly while “genuine deduction tokens keep changing through deep layers,” yielding semantic “reasoning depth classes.” Searches for “token-wise adaptive depth transformer,” “LLM early exit prediction stability,” “logit lens convergence chain-of-thought,” and “semantic role reasoning token depth” identify CALM (Schuster et al., 2022), PABEE (Zhou et al., 2020), Mixture-of-Recursions (2025), AdaPonderLM (2026), and Understanding Dynamic Compute Allocation in Recurrent Transformers (2026) as close precedents for confidence/stability-based early exit or token-level compute allocation, but not for a semantic-role taxonomy of convergence depth in pretrained CoT models. Moving from those works to training-free logit-lens halting is a natural adaptation of established early-exit machinery, while the predicted role-to-depth relationship is a non-trivial but fairly predictable new operationalization rather than a new adaptive-computation paradigm.
